note: Scenario packs built ONLY from vendored authentic recordings (replay phases) and existing native scenario packs (native phases). Independent recordings are aligned in time only: no identifier is rewritten to fake a shared incident, so correlation_level is TEMPORAL_ONLY unless a phase comes from one native pack. Industry mappings are editorial (maintainer judgement), not customer-validated.

packs.title: Linux credential-file access with system context (replayed recordings)
packs.objective: Show shadow/passwd file access recorded by auditd against ordinary Linux system messages, on the current clock.
packs.expected_outcome: auditd PROCTITLE/EXECVE records for credential-file reads appear after a baseline of Linux messages in one run.
packs.detection_prerequisites: Splunk Add-on for Unix and Linux (not installed in any lab); no detection claimed.
packs.verification_spl: index=dev_test_replay source="pulseforge:replay:rp_linux_credential_access:*" | stats count by netspout_phase, sourcetype

packs.title: AWS control-plane activity (replayed CloudTrail)
packs.objective: Replay recorded CloudTrail API activity so cloud audit searches and dashboards have live-dated data.
packs.expected_outcome: 12 CloudTrail records per cycle with their original spacing, dated to the replay clock.
packs.detection_prerequisites: Splunk Add-on for AWS (not installed); no detection claimed.

packs.title: Windows endpoint process and network activity (replayed Sysmon)
packs.objective: Replay recorded Sysmon XML events (process, network, file) as a stream of endpoint telemetry.
packs.expected_outcome: 102 complete Sysmon events per cycle; SystemTime re-stamped, every other byte as recorded.
packs.detection_prerequisites: Splunk Add-on for Sysmon (validated in the isolated lab for parsing only); no detection claimed.

packs.title: Web exploitation observed from three recordings (aligned in time only)
packs.objective: Show web access, network IDS and file-transfer session recordings in one timeline.
packs.expected_outcome: NGINX access, Suricata EVE and CrushFTP session records in three ordered phases.
packs.detection_prerequisites: No TA for these sources is installed; no detection claimed.
packs.verification_spl: index=dev_test_replay source="pulseforge:replay:rp_web_exploitation_recordings:*" | stats count by netspout_phase, sourcetype

packs.title: Endpoint sensor and cloud audit side by side (aligned in time only)
packs.objective: Replay CrowdStrike sensor events with CloudTrail activity for a combined endpoint-and-cloud view.
packs.expected_outcome: 43 sensor events then 12 CloudTrail records per cycle.
packs.detection_prerequisites: CrowdStrike and AWS add-ons are not installed; no detection claimed.
